lines.text: Paul asks the Corinthians to make room for his team in their hearts, saying they have wronged no one.
When Paul's team arrived in Macedonia, God comforted them by the arrival of Titus.
In Galatia, Paul's team faced conflicts outside and fears within, and God comforted them by the arrival of Titus.
Paul rejoices because the Corinthians' sorrow led them to repentance, and he says worldly sorrow brings death.
Titus was refreshed by the Corinthians, and Paul was not embarrassed by his boasting to Titus about them.
